defects.description: Backticked code tokens must be byte-identical to the source. The state identifiers were translated into Russian.
The phrase 'falls back to' (meaning to use a default/alternative) is mistranslated as 'подагент' (sub-agent), which is a hallucination and changes the meaning of the sentence.
Gender mismatch: the adjectives 'высокой/критической' (feminine) do not agree with the masculine noun 'Вывод' (Finding).
